title: Fueling Alternatives: Gas Station Choice and the Implications for Electric Charging
abstract: This paper quantifies the value of electric vehicle (EV) charging networks and the marginal value of network speed and density. We estimate a model of gasoline drivers’ refueling preferences and simulate how these potential future EV drivers value refueling time under counterfactual charging networks. Drivers value refueling time at $19.73/hour. EV adopters with home charging receive $675 per vehicle in benefits from avoiding travel to gas stations, whereas refueling travel and waiting time costs $7,763 for drivers using public charging. Increasing network charging speed yields three times greater time savings than a proportional increase in station density. (JEL D12, H54, Q42, Q58, R41)
abstract_zh: 本文量化了电动汽车充电网络的价值，以及充电网络速度和密度的边际价值。我们估计了燃油驾驶者的加油偏好模型，并模拟了潜在未来电动汽车驾驶者在反事实充电网络下如何评价加油时间。驾驶者对加油时间的估值为每小时19.73美元。拥有家用充电设施的电动汽车使用者，因无需前往加油站而每辆车获得675美元的收益；而使用公共充电的驾驶者，其加油途中的出行与等待时间成本高达7,763美元。提高网络充电速度所节约的时间，是等比例增加站点密度所节约时间的三倍。（JEL分类号：D12、H54、Q42、Q58、R41）

title: Soaking Up the Sun: Battery Investment, Renewable Energy, and Market Equilibrium
abstract: Renewable energy and battery storage are seen as complementary technologies that can together facilitate reductions in carbon emissions. We develop and estimate a framework to calculate the equilibrium effects of large‐scale battery storage. Using data from California, we find that the first storage unit breaks even by 2024 without subsidies when the renewable energy share reaches 50%. Equilibrium effects are important: the first 5000 MWh of storage capacity would reduce wholesale electricity prices by 5.6%, but an increase from 25,000 to 50,000 MWh would only reduce these prices by 2.6%. Large‐scale batteries will reduce revenues to both dispatchable generators and renewable energy sources. The equilibrium effects lead battery adoption to be virtually non‐existent until 2030, without a storage mandate or subsidy. A 30% capital cost subsidy—such as the one in the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act—achieves 5000 MWh of battery capacity by 2024, similar to the level required under California's storage mandate.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源与电池储能被视为互补技术，二者共同作用可促进碳排放的减少。我们构建并估计了一个框架，用于计算大规模电池储能的均衡效应。利用加利福尼亚的数据，我们发现，当可再生能源占比达到50%时，第一台储能设备将在2024年无需补贴即实现盈亏平衡。均衡效应十分重要：前5000兆瓦时的储能容量可使批发电价降低5.6%，但将容量从25000兆瓦时增至50000兆瓦时，仅能使电价降低2.6%。大规模电池储能将减少可调度发电商和可再生能源发电商的收入。均衡效应使得在没有储能强制要求或补贴的情况下，电池采用在2030年之前几乎不存在。若采用如美国《通胀削减法案》（Inflation Reduction Act）中的30%资本成本补贴，则可在2024年前实现5000兆瓦时的电池容量，与加利福尼亚储能强制要求所要求的水平相近。

title: Unequal Uptake: Assessing Distributional Disparities in the Residential Solar Market
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Waiting for the Courts: Effects of Policy Uncertainty on Pollution and Investment
Solar Market Frictions: The Role of Platforms and Policies
abstract: This paper estimates a structural model of the solar photovoltaic (PV) installation market using detailed data from an online platform. The model incorporates households' solar installation choices and sellers' strategic bidding. Counterfactual simulations evaluate how equilibrium outcomes respond to changes in market structure and government subsidies, yielding two main results: (1) an increase from one to five bids through the platform reduces gross installation prices by $4,000 (15.5%), and (2) the U.S. Solar Investment Tax Credit increases total surplus on the platform by $1.35 per dollar of subsidy expenditure by mitigating market power and reducing pollution externalities.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个在线平台的详细数据，估计了太阳能光伏（PV）安装市场的结构模型。该模型纳入了家庭的太阳能安装选择以及卖方的战略性报价。反事实模拟评估了均衡结果如何响应市场结构和政府补贴的变化，得出两项主要结论：（1）通过该平台将报价数量从一个增加到五个，可使毛安装价格降低4,000美元（15.5%）；（2）美国太阳能投资税收抵免通过缓解市场势力并减少污染外部性，使平台上的总剩余每花费1美元补贴增加1.35美元。

title: Pollution Pricing in Equilibrium: Production, Reallocation, and Aggregate Impacts
abstract: How much does pricing pollution cut aggregate emissions, and at what cost? We develop a microfounded equilibrium model of firm production and abatement that can be estimated from standard firm financial and emissions data, without observing abatement effort directly. The model captures three adjustment margins: short-run input substitution, reallocation of output from dirty to cleaner firms, and long-run clean technology adoption. Applying it to the first 17 years of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU-ETS), we find input substitution is rigid: firms cannot cut emissions in the short run without cutting output. Reallocation instead drives nearly all of the short-run aggregate emissions response, concentrated in sectors with heterogeneous emissions intensities, like power and cement, or with elastic demand, like refining. Clean technology adoption also responds causally to permit price shocks, reducing firms' emissions intensity over the five years that follow. Doubling the permit price cuts aggregate emissions 23% in the short run and 31% in the longer run after induced clean technology adoption. In the short run, output falls by 4%, primarily because carbon costs pass from upstream polluting industries like electricity to downstream producers. In the long run, output falls just 2.5%, as clean technology adoption dampens these supply-chain impacts. Carbon pricing thus delivers substantial emissions reductions with moderate output effects, and much of the economic burden falls on downstream firms through higher upstream input costs.
abstract_zh: 对污染进行定价能在多大程度上降低总排放，代价又是多少？我们构建了一个具有微观基础的企业生产与减排均衡模型，该模型可以利用标准的企业财务和排放数据进行估计，而无需直接观测减排努力。该模型刻画了三个调整渠道：短期的投入替代、产出从高排放企业向低排放企业的再配置，以及长期的清洁技术采用。将该模型应用于欧盟排放交易体系（EU-ETS）的前17年，我们发现投入替代是僵化的：企业在短期内无法在不减少产出的情况下削减排放。相反，再配置几乎驱动了全部的短期总量排放响应，并集中于排放强度存在异质性的行业（如电力和水泥），或需求富有弹性的行业（如炼油）。清洁技术采用也对排放许可价格冲击产生因果性的响应，并在随后的五年内降低了企业的排放强度。将排放许可价格翻倍，可使总排放在短期内降低23%，在考虑诱致性清洁技术采用后的长期内降低31%。在短期内，产出下降4%，主要原因是碳成本从电力等上游高污染行业传导至下游生产者。在长期内，产出仅下降2.5%，因为清洁技术采用缓解了这些供应链影响。因此，碳定价能够带来可观的减排效果，同时产出影响适中，且大部分经济负担通过上游投入成本的提高而落在下游企业身上。
